title: Autopsy and Witness
author: Yara Villalobos
blurb: Isandro Thackeray, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
